record.question: Which of the following is a secondary air pollutant?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation: Ground-level ozone forms in the atmosphere through photochemical reactions involving volatile organic compounds and nitrogen oxides. Because it forms from precursor pollutants rather than being emitted directly in that form, ozone is the secondary pollutant among these options.
